valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), USD per MDLZ share (US-listed common, no ADR/FX conversion). FY2025 adjusted EPS $2.92; FY2026 guidance adjusted EPS growth flat to +5% constant currency plus about $0.04 FX (Q3 2026 release), implying about $3.00-3.10; FY2027 built from that base. Stifel's published estimates ($3.05 FY26, $3.36 FY27) used only as a cross-check, not as an anchor. Primary 8-K/10-K pages could not be fetched in this session (sec.gov blocked), so figures come from secondary summaries of the releases.

bear.driver: Cocoa relief stalls and 2027 inflation/volume weakness hold FY2027 adjusted EPS near FY2026 levels

base.driver: Lower cocoa costs and productivity lift margin; about 2% organic growth; EPS growth of roughly 7-8% from a ~$3.06 FY2026 base, consistent with management's confidence in strong 2027 EPS growth

bull.driver: Faster margin recovery (Q3 adjusted operating margin already +190bp to 13.9%) and volume/mix acceleration

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $3.30 the close of $66.28 implies 20.1x; the analyst-weighted target of about $73 implies 22.1x at base EPS, or EPS about $3.56 at a constant 20.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.30 (about 5.0 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: Adjusted operating margin and constant-currency adjusted EPS growth, which must show Q4 2026 delivery of the flat-to-+5% full-year range (nine-month EPS is -4.1% cc)
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 earnings release, expected February 2027 (date not confirmed)

analyst_notes: Six brokers raised or reaffirmed Buy-equivalent ratings after Q3 (Oct 29); targets moved up $2-7 to $68-75 (Goldman 68 to 75, TD Cowen 70 to 75, Stifel 68 to 74, BNP 70 to 72, Barclays 70 to 72, Wells 65 to 68). The sample is all Buy-equivalent and all targets post-date earnings, so it is concentrated and likely skewed positive; names are mostly not published in the sources, and target horizons are not documented so the weighted target excludes them. The analyst average sits above the base case by roughly 8 pp of upside, equivalent to about 1.6 P/E turns or about $0.25 of FY2027 EPS; the sources do not say which the brokers assume. Some aggregators date TD Cowen and Wells actions Oct 16 rather than Oct 30; JPMorgan $72 (from $71) was seen only in a snippet and omitted.
